curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the exit chain against rollaways, then permitted highway stops, breakdowns and keeping children clear

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the angle entry from scan to centering, then the angle exit from creeping back to the sightline halt
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on entry checks, rear clearance, horn taps and the sightline halt
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what to confirm before steering in, how to finish an entry and where to halt on the way out

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the parallel sequence and its spacing faults, then hill parking distance and bracing, then hill starts

curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on who holds a permit, what misuse earns and the hydrant, crosswalk and rail distances
